attrs.evidence: Four constructions. CE-A kills it on a TREE (site 1 pins v=0, site 2 pins v=1; the carrier is the path a–v–b, so there is no cycle to split) — cyclicity is therefore not the obstruction at all for a general language. CE-B does it at |D|=2 with every relation having full projections, refuting the natural 'arc-consistent language' repair. CE-C repeats the shape at |D|=3 with Z₃ sums.
